Experience
Sep 2026 • Family
We visited 4P’s Pizza at D1Mension Residences, and the food was absolutely awesome and delicious. Unfortunately, there were a couple of things that took away from an otherwise enjoyable dining experience.

While serving the dishes, the staff held the food in their hands while explaining the dishes to us from very close range. Because they were speaking so close to the food, I was concerned about saliva droplets potentially reaching the dishes. I found this quite unpleasant and felt that it could be handled in a more hygienic way.

The toilet was another disappointment. It was quite smelly and did not appear to be very clean or well maintained, which was surprising given the restaurant's overall standard.

The food itself was excellent, but I hope the restaurant will pay more attention to food-handling and hygiene practices. These small details can make a big difference to the overall dining experience.

Thank you for helping us improve our standards. We hope to have another opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with a much better experience in the future. Wishing you a wonderful day ahead!

Worth a Visit!

This Pizza place is worth a visit… there’s a lot of variety to choose from Meaty, vegan or classic favourites. It was really food to sit on the bar and see for myself fresh pizza made to perfection…. As i waited for my half prosciutto and Salami/chorizo pizza..i wanted to order more but i was too full but never will i missed dessert, Tiramisu hits like home 🤤🤤🤤 creamy and easy that l coffee and chocolate combo is definitely worth it ordering again… 

The Ambiance was a perfect balance of boogie, posh, relaxed and that hint of smell of honeyscuckle was soooo good.. ( im not sure if its the food or the scent of the whole place) but it was sooo nice..😍 

The crew were fantastic always make sure you got everything you need, friendly and very accommodating… 

Cheers guys! I hope i get to try other dishes i have been eyeing on… 🤩
